summary: Appending a commit to the library and waiting for the store's acknowledgement.
work: Sends a commit's entries to the host store and records its acknowledgement or refusal.
cancel: Appends are never cancelled; an unacknowledged commit stays pending.
lane: page, the person's own, in commit order

x-friction.gap: An unacknowledged commit must survive a crash of both sides.
x-friction.closes: Pending changes kept durably until acknowledged.
